describes: The key set: art direction on top of the derived light, never in place of it (docs/research/lighting-and-colour.md, the short of it, 1 and 4). Rows are keyed by the sun's elevation (millidegrees, clamped at -18000), a side of the day (morning, evening or both, blended by the evening weight from the sun's hour angle) and a weather regime (clear, overcast, fog, blended by the weather's weights); between two rows of a regime and side a push is interpolated by elevation, and a target a row leaves out is no push there. Pushes name terms in schemas/light-terms.json. Hashed as the record's keys source.
